front_office.name: Front Office
front_office.description: Revenue-generating, market-facing functions of the trading organization: trading and deal execution, forecasting, pre-trade analysis, bidding strategy, and customer/counterparty engagement.

middle_office.name: Middle Office
middle_office.description: Control and analytical layer between front and back office: monitors market and credit risk and exposure, validates captured trades, calculates P&L, manages confirmations and scenario modelling, and enforces risk limits, controls, and compliance.

back_office.name: Back Office
back_office.description: Administrative and operational completion of the trade lifecycle: settlements, invoicing and netting, accounting and sub-ledger management, regulatory reporting, dispute resolution, and record-keeping.

operations.name: Operations
operations.description: Physical supply chain execution supporting the traded book: scheduling, movement actualization, feedstock and product inventory management, transportation, and terminal operations.
